# Mommy Poppins

> > Mommy Poppins is a comprehensive family entertainment platform offering activity guides, event listings, and parenting resources for families with children of all ages.

Mommy Poppins serves as a centralized hub for parents seeking kid-friendly activities, entertainment options, and parenting guidance across the United States. The site combines an event calendar and business directory with extensive how-to guides covering crafts, STEM learning, cooking, and child development.

## Core Platform

- [Mommy Poppins - Things to Do with Kids](https://mommypoppins.com): Homepage featuring family activities, events, and things to do with kids
- [Activity Search and Event Calendar](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere): Activity search and event calendar for family entertainment nationwide
- [Business Listings and Advertising](https://mommypoppins.com/mommy-poppins-business-listings): Business directory and advertising platform for family activity providers

## Creative Activities & Learning

- [Ultimate Guide To Crafts for Kids: Thousands of Craft Ideas](https://mommypoppins.com/family/weework-craft-projects-kids-easy-indoor-activities): Comprehensive craft guide with DIY projects for toddlers through teens
- [Science Experiments and STEM Activities for Kids](https://mommypoppins.com/family/stem/guide-to-science-experiments-for-kids-and-fun-stem-activities): Educational STEM guide with science experiments and learning activities
- [Games & Activities Guide for Kids of All Ages](https://mommypoppins.com/family/coronavirus-pandemic-update-indoor-activities-resources-kids): Indoor activities, games, and educational resources for kids at home
- [Easy Recipes for Kids](https://mommypoppins.com/family/easy-recipes-for-kids-guide): Kid-friendly recipes including cooking activities and family dinners

## Age-Specific Guides

- [Baby and Maternity Guide](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere-family/baby-maternity-guide-pregnancy-parenting): Pregnancy, baby development, and early parenting guidance and resources
- [Teen and Tween Activities Guide](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere-family/teen-tween-activities-guide): Activities, gift ideas, and parenting advice for teenagers and tweens
- [Mommy Poppins Parenting Guide](https://mommypoppins.com/family/parent-talk/mommy-poppins-parenting-guide): Parenting tips, advice, and guidance for raising children of all ages

## Planning & Celebrations

- [Guide to Kids' Birthday Parties and Birthday Party Ideas](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere-family/virtual/birthday-party-ideas-guide): Birthday party planning guide with themes, games, and celebration ideas
- [National Summer Camp Guide](https://mommypoppins.com/family/national-summer-camp-guide): Comprehensive summer camp directory with tips and recommendations nationwide
- [Mommy Poppins Holiday Gift Guide 2026 for Kids](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere-family/mommy-poppins-gift-guide-birthdays-holidays): Age-specific gift recommendations for birthdays and holidays

## Holiday Activities & Guides

- [Christmas Activities and Holiday Fun for Kids](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere-family/christmashanukkah/christmas-activities-for-kids): Christmas and Hanukkah activities, crafts, and holiday entertainment
- [Halloween Activities and Events for Kids](https://mommypoppins.com/family/halloween-activities-guide-for-families): Halloween activities, crafts, and events for families nationwide
- [Thanksgiving Activities Guide for Families](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere-family/thanksgiving-activities-guide-families): Thanksgiving activities, crafts, recipes, and family celebration ideas

## Optional Resources

- [Virtual and Online Guide for Family Fun](https://mommypoppins.com/virtual-and-online-guide-for-family-fun): Guide to online activities, games, and virtual entertainment for families
- [Products Guide to Our Favorite Tried and Tested Toys and Gear](https://mommypoppins.com/anywhere-family/stores-services/products-gear-guide-baby-kids): Curated product recommendations and gear guide for babies through teens
